item.title: Adobe Expands Creative Cloud with New AI Editing Tools
item.description:
Adobe Expands Creative Cloud with New AI Editing Tools

Adobe announced new AI capabilities for Creative Cloud apps and its Firefly platform at the Max event, aiming to speed up design and editing tasks.

🔍 Overview

  • Adobe is expanding Creative Cloud apps and Firefly AI platform with new capabilities.
  • Announcements include automatic removal of objects, blemishes, and distractions in Premiere, Photoshop, and Lightroom, plus new generative AI tools and collaborative experiences.

🧩 How it works

  • Premiere Generative Remove (beta)
    • Mask an object, click Remove; Premiere fills the area with realistic detail using generative AI while surrounding footage stays untouched.
  • Photoshop updated Remove Tool
    • Better at detecting and reconstructing surrounding elements such as reflections, shadows, and footprints.
  • Photoshop Quick Compare
    • Before‑and‑after split‑screen slider to review changes without switching layers.
  • Photoshop Relight
    • Add and position new light sources to dynamically adjust hue and brightness.
  • Lightroom blemish removal
    • Single‑tap skin retouch on desktop (previously mobile only).
  • Lightroom Open Eyes (public beta)
    • Replaces closed eyes with natural‑looking open eyes using a reference photo from the library.
  • Premiere new sound editing tools
    • Clean messy recordings and separate dialogue, music, ambience, and sound effects into individual tracks.
  • Firefly Quick Actions
    • Ready‑to‑use workflows for creating video thumbnails and product ads, now generally available.
  • Firefly Design
    • Combined space for illustration, image editing, animation, 3D, and print (beta).
  • Firefly Graph
    • Helps creators build and iterate on custom, repeatable workflows.
  • Firefly Builder (private beta)
    • Tool for prototyping websites and apps.

⚙️ Key details

  • Generative Media tool introduced earlier this year is now generally available.
  • Color Mode color editing experience, launched in beta in April, is now generally available.
  • Features are part of Adobe’s broader expansion of Creative Cloud and Firefly AI platform.

🚀 Availability

  • Premiere Generative Remove – beta.
  • Photoshop Remove Tool – updated now.
  • Photoshop Quick Compare and Relight – newly added.
  • Lightroom blemish removal – coming to desktop.
  • Lightroom Open Eyes – public beta.
  • Firefly Quick Actions – generally available.
  • Firefly Design, Graph – beta; Firefly Builder – private beta.
  • Generative Media and Color Mode – generally available.

#Adobe #CreativeCloud #AI #VideoEditing

Source: Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere are making it easier to remove things

item.title: Adobe unveils agentic AI integrations for Creative Cloud at Max 2026
item.description:
Adobe unveils agentic AI integrations for Creative Cloud at Max 2026

Adobe announced at its Max conference in Miami that it is going all in on agentic AI, letting both Adobe‑built and third‑party AI agents act as design assistants, automate repetitive creative tasks, and run continuously in the background.

🔍 Overview

  • Adobe framed chatbots and AI agents as potential next‑generation design assistants.
  • New tools let preferred third‑party agents access and modify Creative Cloud projects, while the Firefly AI Assistant gains expanded capabilities.

🧩 How it works

  • Local Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations let external agents from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc., work locally in Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and After Effects, directly editing native project files.
  • All layers, vectors, bins, and sequences remain editable, so users can take over at any time.
  • Agents can pull reference documents from other MCP‑capable tools (e.g., Google Docs) and share results via Slack.
  • Always‑on agents perform recurring background jobs such as asset organization, quality checks, or content preparation, allowing users to step away from the computer.

⚙️ Key details

  • Third‑party AI agents can use Creative Cloud apps on the user’s behalf and run social‑media accounts via Firefly.
  • Firefly AI Assistant upgrades include:
    • Plan Mode: review, edit, and approve the agent’s plan before execution.
    • Model Selector: choose a specific AI model or let the system auto‑select.
    • Integration with Firefly Boards.
    • Customizable formats, colors, brand guidelines, characters, and products applied automatically across projects.
  • Creative agent extensions now cover Premiere mobile, enabling conversational video edits on the go, and new video‑editing features such as masked subject tracking and batch color/exposure adjustments.

Feature Summary

Integration Capability
MCP local integrations Third‑party agents edit Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects files locally
Firefly AI Assistant Runs social‑media accounts, Plan Mode, Model Selector, Boards, brand‑wide customization
Always‑on agents Continuous background tasks like asset organization and automated graphic generation

📅 Availability

  • Creative Cloud local MCP integrations are not yet released; a private beta is planned for early 2027.
  • The always‑on preview will arrive first in the Firefly AI Assistant, though Adobe has not given a launch date.

💡 Why it matters

  • Designers can offload repetitive or ongoing work to AI agents while retaining full editability of their projects.
  • Integration of third‑party bots expands the ecosystem beyond Adobe’s own tools, giving users flexibility to employ familiar AI models.
  • Continuous background agents free up creative time, enabling focus on higher‑level decisions.

#Adobe #AIagents #CreativeCloud #Firefly

Source: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
